# Ratio and Regression Estimation ## Functions and packages for Analyzing Data ### General functions for ratio and regression estimation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ## ydata --- observations of the variable of interest ## xdata --- observations of the auxilliary variable ## N --- population size ## xbarU --- population mean of auxilliary variable ## the output is the estimate mean or total (est.total=TRUE) srs_reg_est <- function (ydata, xdata, xbarU, N = Inf, est.total = FALSE) { n <- length (ydata) lmfit <- lm (ydata ~ xdata) Bhat <- lmfit$coefficients efit <- lmfit$residuals SSe <- sum (efit^2) / (n - 2) yhat_reg <- Bhat[1] + Bhat[2] * xbarU se_yhat_reg <- sqrt ((1-n/N) * SSe / n) mem <- qt (0.975, df = n - 2) * se_yhat_reg output <- c(yhat_reg, se_yhat_reg, yhat_reg - mem, yhat_reg + mem) if (est.total) { if(!is.finite(N)) stop("N must be finite for estimating population total" ) output <- output * N } names (output) <- c("Est.", "S.E.", "ci.low", "ci.upp" ) output } ## ydata --- observations of the variable of interest ## xdata --- observations of the auxilliary variable ## N --- population size ## the output is the ratio of ybarU/xbarU srs_ratio_est <- function (ydata, xdata, N = Inf) { n <- length (xdata) xbar <- mean (xdata) ybar <- mean (ydata) B_hat <- ybar / xbar d <- ydata - B_hat * xdata var_d <- sum (d^2) / (n - 1) sd_B_hat <- sqrt ((1 - n/N) * var_d / n) / xbar mem <- qt (0.975, df = n - 1) * sd_B_hat output <- c (B_hat, sd_B_hat, B_hat - mem, B_hat + mem ) names (output) <- c("Est.", "S.E.", "ci.low", "ci.upp" ) output } ## sdata --- a vector of original survey data in a domain ## N --- population size ## n --- total sample size (not the sample size in the domain) ## to find total, multiply domain size N_d to the estimate returned by this function srs_domain_mean_est <- function (sdata, n, N = Inf) { n_d <- length (sdata) ybar <- mean (sdata) se.ybar <- sqrt((1 - n / N)) * sd (sdata) / sqrt(n_d) mem <- qt (0.975, df = n_d - 1) * se.ybar c (Est. = ybar, S.E. = se.ybar, ci.low = ybar - mem, ci.upp = ybar + mem) } ## sdata --- a vector of original survey data ## N --- population size ## to find total, multiply N to the estimate returned by this function srs_mean_est <- function (sdata, N = Inf) { n <- length (sdata) ybar <- mean (sdata) se.ybar <- sqrt((1 - n / N)) * sd (sdata) / sqrt(n) mem <- qt (0.975, df = n - 1) * se.ybar c (Est. = ybar, S.E. = se.ybar, ci.low = ybar - mem, ci.upp = ybar + mem) } ``` ::: ### Post-stratification For poststratification, plug in $n_h = n * {N_h \over N}$ in the estimator for a real stratified sample ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ## to find total, multiply N to the estimate returned by this function str_mean_estimate <- function (ybarh, sh, nh, Nh) { N <- sum (Nh) Pi_h <- Nh/N ybar <- sum(ybarh * Pi_h) seybar <- sqrt(sum((1-nh/Nh)*Pi_h^2*sh^2/nh)) mem <- 1.96 * seybar c(Est. = ybar, S.E. = seybar, ci.low = ybar - mem, ci.upp = ybar + mem) } ``` ::: ## Ratio Estimation for cherry.csv dataset ### Importing data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cherry <- read.csv ("data/cherry.csv", header = T) cherry ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} plot (cherry$volume ~ cherry$diameter) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ratio_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} summary (lm(cherry$volume ~ 0+cherry$diameter)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Call: lm(formula = cherry$volume ~ 0 + cherry$diameter) Residuals: Min 1Q Median 3Q Max -11.104 -8.470 -6.199 1.883 27.129 Coefficients: Estimate Std. S.E. ci.low ci.upp 89517.261 8713.665 71721.583 107312.940 ``` ::: ::: ### Step-by-step calculation for Ratio Estimation #### Estimating B and calculating residuals ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ## input ydata <- cherry$volume xdata <- cherry$diameter N <- 2967 ## calculation n <- length (xdata) xbar <- mean (xdata) ybar <- mean (ydata) B_hat <- ybar / xbar ## ratio estimate plot (cherry$volume ~ cherry$diameter) abline (a = 0, b = B_hat) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ratio_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} d <- ydata - 1) ## variance of errors sd_B_hat <- sqrt ((1 - n/N) * var_d / n) / xbar ## SE for B mem <- qt (0.975, df = n - 1) * sd_B_hat ## margin error for B ## output output_B <- c (B_hat, sd_B_hat, B_hat - mem, B_hat + mem ) names (output_B) <- c("Est.", "S.E.", "ci.low", "ci.upp" ) output_B ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Est. S.E. ci.low ci.upp 95272.159 5471.434 84097.999 106446.318 ``` ::: ::: ### Ratio estimation with a function #### Estimating the ratio of volume to diameter ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} B_v2d <- srs_ratio_est (ydata = cherry$volume, xdata = cherry$diameter, N = 2967) B_v2d ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Est. S.E. ci.low ci.upp 2.277331 0.130786 2.010231 2.544432 ``` ::: ::: #### Estimating the mean of volume ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} xbarU <- 41835/N ratio_mean_volume <- srs_ratio_est (ydata = cherry$volume, xdata = cherry$diameter, N = 2967) * xbarU ratio_mean_volume ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Est. S.E. ci.low ci.upp 32.110603 1.844097 28.344455 35.876750 ``` ::: ::: #### Estimating the total of volume ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} total_diameters <- 41835 srs_ratio_est (ydata = cherry$volume, xdata = cherry$diameter, N = 2967) * total_diameters ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Est. S.E. ci.low ci.upp 95272.159 5471.434 84097.999 106446.318 ``` ::: ::: #### Percentage of Variance Reduction ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cat(1-(ratio_mean_volume[2]/srs_mean_volume[2])^2) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 0.6057237 ``` ::: ::: ## Simulation study with agpop.csv ### Information of population data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} agpop <- read.csv ("data/agpop.csv") agpop <- agpop[agpop$acres92 != -99, ] ## remove those counties with na # sample size n <- 300 # population size N <- nrow (agpop) # true values that we want to estimate tyU <- sum (agpop [,"acres92"]) # suppose known for ratio estimate txU <- sum (agpop [,"acres87"]) B <- tyU/txU plot (agpop [, "acres87"], agpop [, "acres92"]) abline(a=0,b=B) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ratio_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-13-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # expected reduction of variance of ratio estimate to srs 1-var(agpop$acres92-B*agpop$acres87)/var(agpop$acres92) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.9917355 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # linear model output summary(lm(agpop$acres92 ~ agpop$acres87)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Call: lm(formula = agpop$acres92 ~ agpop$acres87) Residuals: Min 1Q Median 3Q Max -642399 -8256 -692 5593 656458 Coefficients: Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|) (Intercept) -2.121e+03 8.648e+02 -2.453 0.0142 * agpop$acres87 9.878e-01 1.626e-03 607.388 <2e-16 *** --- Signif. codes: 0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1 Residual standard error: 38560 on 3057 degrees of freedom Multiple R-squared: 0.9918, Adjusted R-squared: 0.9918 F-statistic: 3.689e+05 on 1 and 3057 DF, p-value: < 2.2e-16 ``` ::: ::: ### Simulation Studies ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nsim <- 2000 sim_rat <- data.frame ( simple = rep (0, nsim), ratio = rep (0, nsim), B = rep (0, nsim)) for (i in 1:nsim) { srs <- sample (N,n) y_srs <- agpop[srs, "acres92"] x_srs <- agpop[srs, "acres87"] # SRS estimate sim_rat$simple [i] <- mean (y_srs) * N # ratio estimate sim_rat$B [i] <- mean (y_srs) / mean (x_srs) sim_rat$ratio [i] <- sim_rat$B [i] * txU } sim_rat[1:20,] ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} boxplot (sim_rat [, 1:2]) abline (h = tyU, col = "red") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](ratio_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-14-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} sim_var <- sapply (sim_rat[,1:2], var) ratio_sim_var <- sim_var/sim_var[1] percentage_reduction <- 1-ratio_sim_var data.frame (sim_var, ratio_sim_var,percentage_reduction) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Estimating Domain Means and Post-stratification with agsrs.csv example ### Estimating Domain Means ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} agsrs <- read.csv("data/agsrs.csv") n <- nrow (agsrs) n ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 300 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ## estimating domain means region_agsrs_domain <- data.frame(rbind( NC = srs_domain_mean_est(agsrs$acres92[agsrs$region=="NC"], n=n, N = 3078), NE = srs_domain_mean_est(agsrs$acres92[agsrs$region=="NE"], n=n,N = 3078), S = srs_domain_mean_est(agsrs$acres92[agsrs$region=="S"], n=n,N = 3078), W = srs_domain_mean_est(agsrs$acres92[agsrs$region=="W"], n=n,N = 3078)) ) region_agsrs_domain ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ## Compared to the results of naively applying SRS estimation to each domain (wrong analysis) region_agsrs_srs <- data.frame(rbind( NC = srs_mean_est(agsrs$acres92[agsrs$region=="NC"], N = 1054), NE = srs_mean_est(agsrs$acres92[agsrs$region=="NE"], N = 220), S = srs_mean_est(agsrs$acres92[agsrs$region=="S"], N = 1382), W = srs_mean_est(agsrs$acres92[agsrs$region=="W"], N = 422)) ) region_agsrs_srs ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ### Post-stratification Analysis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nh <- tapply (agsrs[, "acres92"], agsrs[,"region"], length) n <- sum (nh) n ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 300 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} sh <- tapply (agsrs[, "acres92"], agsrs[,"region"], sd) ybarh <- tapply (agsrs[, "acres92"], agsrs[,"region"], mean) # create a vector with external information Nh <- c(NC = 1054, NE = 220, S= 1382, W = 422) ``` ::: **Create $n_h^{\mbox{post-strat}}=n\times \frac{N_h}{N}$, instead of using observed $n_h$ ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nh_post <- Nh/sum(Nh)* n ## regional summary for stratified sampling estimation knitr::kable( data.frame( "${\\bar y}_h$"=ybarh, "$s_h$"=sh, "$n_h$"=nh, "$\\pi^{\\mbox{obs}}_h=n_h/n$"=nh/n, "$N_h$"=Nh, "$\\pi^{\\mbox{pop}}_h=N_h/N$"=Nh/sum(Nh), "$n_h^{\\mbox{post-strat}}=n\\times N_h/N$"=nh_post, check.names = FALSE ), ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} | | ${\bar y}_h$| $s_h$| $n_h$| $\pi^{\mbox{obs}}_h=n_h/n$| $N_h$| $\pi^{\mbox{pop}}_h=N_h/N$| $n_h^{\mbox{post-strat}}=n\times N_h/N$| |:--|------------:|--------:|-----:|--------------------------:|-----:|--------------------------:|---------------------------------------:| |NC | 323416.4| 278970.0| 78| 0.2600000| 1054| 0.3424301| 102.7290| |NE | 106549.0| 129320.2| 18| 0.0600000| 220| 0.0714750| 21.4425| |S | 246185.8| 312941.3| 160| 0.5333333| 1382| 0.4489929| 134.6979| |W | 518977.6| 490842.0| 44| 0.1466667| 422| 0.1371020| 41.1306| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ## strata mean estimate str_mean_estimate (ybarh, sh, nh_post, Nh) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Est. S.E. ci.low ci.upp 300051.69 17760.26 265241.58 334861.79 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ## compare with SRS estimate srs_mean_est(agsrs$acres92, N = 3087) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Est. S.E. ci.low ci.upp 297897.05 18901.41 260700.40 335093.69 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} ## compare with true mean mean(agpop$acres92) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 308582.4 ``` ::: ::: ## Estimating Domain Means and Post-stratification with teacher example ### Importing Data and Calculating Contingency Table ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} teacher <- read.csv ("data/college_teacher.csv"); teacher ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} table(teacher[,2:1]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` teacher gender 0 1 1 156 84 2 120 40 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} addmargins(table(teacher[,2:1]), 2) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` teacher gender 0 1 Sum 1 156 84 240 2 120 40 160 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # Proportions of students who want to become a teacher in two domains (female and male) prop.table(table(teacher[,2:1]), margin = "gender") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` teacher gender 0 1 1 0.65 0.35 2 0.75 0.25 ``` ::: ::: ### Domain Summary ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} n <- nrow (teacher) ybarh <- tapply (teacher$teacher, INDEX = teacher$gender, FUN = mean); ybarh ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 1 2 0.35 0.25 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} sh <- tapply (teacher$teacher, INDEX = teacher$gender, FUN = sd); sh ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 1 2 0.4779664 0.4343722 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} nh <- tapply (teacher$teacher, INDEX = teacher$gender, FUN = length) prop_h_obs <- nh/sum (nh); prop_h_obs ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 1 2 0.6 0.4 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} knitr::kable( data.frame('$\\bar y_h$'=ybarh, "$s_h$"=sh, "$n^{\\mbox{obs}}_h$"=nh, "$\\pi^{\\mbox{obs}}_h$"=prop_h_obs, check.names = FALSE) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} | $\bar y_h$| $s_h$| $n^{\mbox{obs}}_h$| $\pi^{\mbox{obs}}_h$| |----------:|---------:|------------------:|--------------------:| | 0.35| 0.4779664| 240| 0.6| | 0.25| 0.4343722| 160| 0.4| ::: ::: ### Estimating Domain Means ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} Nh <- c(3000, 1000) n <- nrow(teacher) data.frame(rbind( female=srs_domain_mean_est(subset(teacher, gender==1)$teacher, n=n, N=4000), male = srs_domain_mean_est(subset(teacher, gender==2)$teacher, n=n, N=4000) )) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ### Post-stratification Analysis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} Nh <- c(3000, 1000) prop_h_pop <- Nh/sum (Nh); prop_h_pop ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.75 0.25 ``` ::: ::: **Create $n_h^{\mbox{post-strat}}=n\times \frac{N_h}{N}$, instead of using observed $n_h$ ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nh_post <- Nh/sum (Nh) * n ## show the differences knitr::kable( data.frame( "${\\hat p}_h$"=ybarh, "$s_h$"=sh, "$n_h$"=nh, "$\\pi^{\\mbox{obs}}_h=n_h/n$"=nh/n, "$N_h$"=Nh, "$\\pi^{\\mbox{pop}}_h=N_h/N$"=Nh/sum(Nh), "$n_h^{\\mbox{post-strat}}=n\\times N_h/N$"=nh_post, check.names = FALSE ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} | ${\hat p}_h$| $s_h$| $n_h$| $\pi^{\mbox{obs}}_h=n_h/n$| $N_h$| $\pi^{\mbox{pop}}_h=N_h/N$| $n_h^{\mbox{post-strat}}=n\times N_h/N$| |------------:|---------:|-----:|--------------------------:|-----:|--------------------------:|---------------------------------------:| | 0.35| 0.4779664| 240| 0.6| 3000| 0.75| 300| | 0.25| 0.4343722| 160| 0.4| 1000| 0.25| 100| ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ## poststratification estimation of mean str_mean_estimate (ybarh, sh, nh_post, Nh) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Est. S.E. ci.low ci.upp 0.32500000 0.02217306 0.28154080 0.36845920 ``` ::: ::: This post-stratification estimate can be also calculated with: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} 0.35*0.75+0.25*0.25 ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.325 ``` ::: ::: ### Comparing to the Analysis with SRS ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} srs_mean_est (teacher$teacher, N=sum(Nh)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Est. S.E. ci.low ci.upp 0.31000000 0.02196545 0.26681751 0.35318249 ``` ::: ::: This answer will be the same as using the observed (sample) gender proportions (0.6 and 0.4) to weight the $\bar y_h$, that is, ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} 0.35*0.6+0.25*0.4 ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.31 ``` ::: ::: It is also equal to naive sample proportion: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} mean (teacher$teacher==1) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.31 ``` ::: ::: ## Regression Estimation for the cherry.csv dataset ### Importing data ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cherry <- read.csv ("data/cherry.csv", header = T) ydata <- cherry$volume xdata <- cherry$diameter t_diameters <- 41835 xbarU <- t_diameters/2967 N <- 2967 ``` ::: ### Step-by-step calculation #### Fitting a linear regression model ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} n <- length (ydata) lmfit <- lm (ydata ~ xdata) summary (lmfit) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Call: lm(formula = ydata ~ xdata) Residuals: Min 1Q Median 3Q Max -8.065 -3.107 0.152 3.495 9.587 Coefficients: Estimate Std.
